title: The 8 Best Mini Cordless Drill 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for mini cordless drill 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at mini cordless drill 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: DEWALT XTREME 12V MAX Brushless Cordless Drill/Driver Kit DCD701F2
products.blurb: Key specs: 12V MAX motor with 265 in-lbs torque, 3/8-inch chuck, 2-speed transmission.
strengths: 265 in-lbs torque is enough for 1/2-inch wood drilling and most fastener driving
3/8-inch chuck handles most standard drill and driver bits
2-speed transmission: low for driving, high for drilling
Two batteries included, one working, one charging at all times
limitations: 12V platform, less battery compatibility with 20V DEWALT tools
Smaller battery capacity than 18V alternatives, shorter run time per charge
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: CRAFTSMAN V20 Cordless 1/2-inch Drill/Driver Kit CMCD700C1
products.blurb: Key specs: 20V MAX battery platform, 280 unit watts out (UWO) power, 2-speed gearbox with keyless chuck.
strengths: 20V battery platform, shares batteries with the broader CRAFTSMAN V20 tool lineup
280 UWO handles heavier drilling than most 12V compact drills
1/2-inch chuck accepts larger bits for drilling hardwood
Lower price than DEWALT or Milwaukee equivalents
limitations: Slightly larger and heavier than true 12V mini drills
CRAFTSMAN battery ecosystem smaller than DEWALT or Milwaukee
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Milwaukee 2407-22 M12 3/8-inch Drill/Driver Kit
products.blurb: Key specs: M12 brushed motor, 275 in-lbs torque, All-metal locking chuck.
strengths: 35% faster drilling and fastening than the prior generation Milwaukee compact drill
All-metal locking chuck is more durable than plastic alternatives on competitive compact drills
Redlink Li-ion electronics protect against overload and overheating
Milwaukee M12 platform, compatible with 100+ M12 tools
limitations: M12 batteries not compatible with M18, separate battery ecosystem

products.name: BLACK+DECKER 8V MAX Cordless Drill/Driver BDCD8C
products.blurb: Key specs: 8V MAX battery, 11-position clutch, 3/8-inch keyless chuck.
strengths: Lowest price on the list, accessible for light home repair use
Small and lightweight, comfortable for long periods of use
11-position clutch handles different fastener sizes without overdriving
limitations: 8V MAX limits to light tasks, not suitable for hardwood drilling or sustained use
Short battery life, small battery capacity depletes quickly
Not suitable for professional or regular woodworking use

products.name: Bosch PS21-2A 12V Max Two-Speed Pocket Driver Kit
products.blurb: Key specs: Smallest body in Bosch 12V lineup, 265 in-lbs torque, 20-position clutch.
strengths: Smallest body dimensions of any 12V drill on this list, fits in a pocket or tool belt loop
265 in-lbs torque competitive with DEWALT 12V at the same voltage
20-position clutch provides finer torque control for delicate fastening
Two batteries included, same as DEWALT comparable kit
limitations: Bosch 12V battery platform smaller than DEWALT or Milwaukee 12V ecosystems
Slightly fewer compatible accessories than DEWALT in the 12V range

products.name: Makita FD07R1 12V Max CXT Lithium-Ion Brushless Cordless Driver-Drill Kit
products.blurb: Key specs: 12V MAX CXT battery, 236 in-lbs torque, 21-position clutch.
strengths: Makita CXT 12V platform, compatible with 35+ CXT tools
21-position clutch provides the finest torque adjustment
Variable speed trigger gives precise control at low speeds for fastening without stripping
Makita build quality, Japanese engineering with long reliability record
limitations: 236 in-lbs torque slightly lower than DEWALT and Milwaukee 12V equivalents
CXT battery slightly larger than Bosch and DEWALT 12V batteries

products.name: WEN 20V Max Cordless 3/8-Inch Drill and Driver 20119
products.blurb: Key specs: 20V lithium-ion battery, 18-position torque control, 3/8-inch keyless chuck.
strengths: 20V voltage at a budget price, more power than 12V alternatives at similar cost
Keyless chuck handles most standard drill and driver bits
LED work light illuminates tight spaces where overhead lighting cannot reach
18-position clutch provides reasonable torque control for the price
limitations: Proprietary battery, not compatible with major brand ecosystems
Build quality lower than DEWALT, Milwaukee, and Makita
Battery longevity shorter than established brands in user reports

products.name: Worx WX176L 20V Power Share Switchdriver 2-in-1 Cordless Drill & Driver
products.blurb: Key specs: 20V PowerShare platform, Brushless motor, 24-position clutch.
strengths: Brushless motor at a mid-range price, longer motor life than brushed alternatives
PowerShare battery works with 100+ Worx tools
24-position clutch is one of the finest adjustments at this price
Compact body with full 1/2-inch chuck capacity
limitations: Worx PowerShare platform smaller ecosystem than DEWALT, Milwaukee, or RYOBI
Brushless motor advantage is lower than on premium brands due to lower-grade electronics
